description: This file defines the RegexpCondition class which implements a conditional 'if-regexp' element for the minilang framework. It evaluates whether a specified field matches a regular expression pattern and executes associated sub-operations based on the result.

classes.name: RegexpCondition
classes.description: Implements an 'if-regexp' conditional operation that evaluates whether a string matches a regex pattern and executes corresponding sub-operations.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates whether the specified field value matches the regex pattern defined in 'expr'.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes sub-operations based on whether the regex match condition is true or false.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from nested operations for analysis.

methods.name: prettyPrint
methods.description: Produces a human-readable string describing the condition and pattern matching.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the 'if-regexp' element with attributes.
